section_summary.extract_value: This section provides a brief review of goal orientation theory, distinguishing between learning orientation and performance orientation. It discusses how these orientations influence engagement in challenging tasks, resource investment, and attitudes toward change. The section concludes by proposing four hypotheses regarding the prediction of proactive and adaptive work role performance by learning-oriented and performance-oriented beliefs.
